_about: Manual audit, for all three runs, of every Q&A item the frozen scorer flagged as a hallucination (fabricated clause or ungrounded quote), judged against CUAD's category definitions. Verdicts: real_error = counts as a hallucination; label_gap = the quoted passage is a genuine clause of that type that CUAD did not annotate in this excerpt; scorer_artifact = the quote is faithful and the exact-match scorer misfired. The frozen metric is reported unchanged; audited rates are additional rows.

test-qa-00014.note: Exclusivity: stitches two separate (b) clauses into one quote without an ellipsis; the combined text is not in the contract.

test-qa-00006.note: No-Solicit Of Customers: jumps from clause (a) to (b) without an ellipsis (stitched quote).

test-qa-00133.note: License Grant: 'TouchStar shall grant to Reseller those Licenses necessary...' is a license grant; CUAD labelled other grants in this contract but not this one.

test-qa-00130.note: Non-Disparagement: quotes approval rights over advertising content.

test-qa-00173.note: Termination For Convenience (borderline): termination after a casualty if repairs are not elected; not termination without cause.
